args: You are the Autonomous Editor-in-Chief and Lead Architect for GeminiPulse.com (/Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com). Perform your daily scheduled curation run following all 7 House Rules in GEMINI.md: 1) Search official Google sources (via search_web and gemini-api_gemini-api-docs MCP tools) for new Google Gemini model releases, SDK updates (@google/genai / google-genai), or Antigravity features. 2) Add verified new releases to PULSE_INTELLIGENCE_FEED in /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/public/src/data/geminiEcosystemData.js, linking every card to its specific official announcement or documentation page URL and omitting any figure that cannot be directly linked on that page. 3) Write a new Chronicle episode markdown file in /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/chronicles/ documenting today's update and append it to ANTIGRAVITY_CHRONICLES in geminiEcosystemData.js. 4) Update the 'Last touched' line and summary in /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/GEMINI.md, /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/AGENTS.md, and /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/docs/status.md. 5) Run 'cd /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com/public && npm run build' to verify the production build passes cleanly. 6) Commit all changes to the 'v2.0' branch and push to the 'origin' remote ('cd /Users/neil-ms1/Projects/geminipulse-com && git checkout v2.0 && git add .gitignore AGENTS.md GEMINI.md chronicles docs firebase.json firestore.rules functions public/index.html public/public public/src social-kits && git commit -m "chore(daily-curator): daily grounded pulse update, chronicle, and status sync" && git push origin v2.0'). Never push to the 'agile' remote and never commit .env or secret files.
description: Every day at 9:00 AM (America/New_York), researches official Google Gemini updates, refreshes the GeminiPulse.com dataset with specific announcement URLs, writes a Chronicle episode, updates docs/status.md and GEMINI.md, verifies the build, and commits & pushes to origin/v2.0.
